title: Uncovering Intermolecular Interactions Driving the Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation of the TDP-43 Low-Complexity Domain via Atomistic Dimerization Simulations.
authors: Tang, Huayuan; Sun, Yunxiang; Wang, Lei; Ke, Pu Chun; Ding, Feng
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子离散分子动力学模拟TDP-43低复杂度结构域的二聚化，研究液-液相分离的分子间相互作用，虽涉及蛋白自组装与突变效应，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上对分子互作模拟有间接参考价值。
abstract: Liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) of transactive response DNA-binding protein of 43 kDa (TDP-43), which exerts multiple functions in the splicing, trafficking, and stabilization of RNA, mediates the formation of membraneless condensates with crucial physiological roles, while its aberrant LLPS is linked to multiple neurodegenerative diseases. However, due to the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of LLPS, major gaps remain in understanding the precise intermolecular interactions driving LLPS and how specific mutations alter LLPS dynamics. Here, we investigated the molecular mechanisms underlying the LLPS of the TDP-43 low-complexity domain (LCD) by simulating the dimerization process using all-atom discrete molecular dynamics with microsecond-long simulations. Our results showed that the TDP-43 LCD was intrinsically disordered, with helical structures consistent with prior nuclear magnetic resonance studies. Phase separation propensity was assessed by simulating the dimerization of the TDP-43 LCD and four mutants, showing that A321G, W334G, and M337V inhibited self-association, while G335D promoted it, fully consistent with experimental reports. During the dimerization process, two peptides experienced both elastic and nonelastic collisions, and the self-associated dimer featured both high- and low-contact states. These results suggested that the dimerization process of the TDP-43 LCD was accordingly dynamic and heterogeneous. Additionally, we identified crucial regions containing hydrophobic clusters and aromatic residues in the N-terminus, central region, and C-terminus that were essential for the self-association of the TDP-43 LCD. These residues with high binding affinities can act as stickers to form peptide networks in LLPS. Together, our simulation provides a comprehensive picture of the intermolecular interactions driving the phase separation of the TDP-43 LCD, offering insights into both physiological functions and pathological mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 43 kDa反式激活反应DNA结合蛋白（TDP-43）的液-液相分离（LLPS）在RNA的剪接、运输和稳定化中发挥多种功能，介导具有关键生理作用的无膜凝聚体的形成，而其异常LLPS与多种神经退行性疾病相关。然而，由于LLPS的异质性和动态性，在理解驱动LLPS的精确分子间相互作用以及特定突变如何改变LLPS动态方面仍存在重大空白。在此，我们通过使用全原子离散分子动力学并进行微秒级模拟，研究了TDP-43低复杂度结构域（LCD）的LLPS分子机制，模拟了其二聚化过程。我们的结果表明，TDP-43 LCD本质上是无序的，其螺旋结构与先前的核磁共振研究一致。通过模拟TDP-43 LCD及其四个突变体的二聚化过程评估了相分离倾向，显示A321G、W334G和M337V抑制自结合，而G335D促进自结合，这与实验报告完全一致。在二聚化过程中，两条肽经历了弹性碰撞和非弹性碰撞，自结合二聚体同时具有高接触和低接触状态。这些结果表明，TDP-43 LCD的二聚化过程相应地具有动态性和异质性。此外，我们识别了N端、中央区域和C端含有疏水簇和芳香族残基的关键区域，这些区域对TDP-43 LCD的自结合至关重要。这些具有高结合亲和力的残基可作为粘附点，在LLPS中形成肽网络。综合来看，我们的模拟提供了驱动TDP-43 LCD相分离的分子间相互作用的全面图景，为生理功能和病理机制提供了见解。
